posts.title: Better rendering of track changes and numbering portions in Collabora Online Writer
posts.description: Numbering portions are the special creatures that are automatically generated at the start of a paragraph for Arabic numbering or bullets. They are there before the paragraph even starts, and now the track changes rendering for them is better. This post is meant to show how this looked in the past and what we improved recently.
